assets.source: 本轮独立授权重新生成：羊躯、单耳、单尾分别经过 Gen-2.5-Medium → Blender 矫正及 Read 四视图 → Gen-2.5-Extreme-High，34 首图、HighPack、50,000 面，未加 texture_mode 附费。羊躯 HIGH 首次产生补片硬折面，重做连续 Medium 雕刻引导后重新 HIGH；7 笔真实事务共 5.5 积分，独立本轮上限 12，起始账本 67 行且猼訑历史计费 0。采用新的 HIGH-v2 有机羊躯及原生四足分蹄、四份新 HIGH 单耳、九份新 HIGH 有体积毛尾；旧饕餮羊躯、原程序直杆腿、方蹄和刺条尾均已替换。背目眼数为推断，原创眼组件逐顶点贴合实际背部曲面，面部不补眼。足底局部平整、加深趾间裂隙并沿共边分离实际蹄网格；同一足骨绑定接缝。独立 98 骨，四耳九尾双背目和 idle/walk/special；714,527 三角面，3,924,436 字节，meshopt/WebP，不减面、不 flatten、不 join。UUID、全部原始 HIGH SHA256、未采用首轮、四视图逐图哈希及本轮 baseline 均在 pipeline/provenance/boyi.json。脚本 prepare_boyi.py、rig_boyi.py、scripts/qa-boyi.mjs。
assets.sourceReference: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/山海經/南山經 · 南山經之首 · 基山。原文其狀如羊、九尾四耳、其目在背、佩之不畏；背目数量、无角、毛色、耳尾形状及羊鸣均在 inferred 中明确标出。佩之不畏不是主动攻击法术。

assets.source: Offline reuse of verified zheng-body-max and zheng-tail-max, both Gen-2.5-Extreme-High with 50,000 raw triangles each; normalized donors contain 49,751 and 49,964 triangles. The native upper feline shoulder/throat tissue is smoothly deformed into two branches and voxel-unioned, then actually stitched across six open boundary loops to retained lower body and complete lateral head surfaces. Retained UVs and a donor-projected coat atlas preserve the original fur; unintended pink sternum texels are neutralized. No buried cut caps or primitive neck sleeves. Independent three-bone neck chains, a single reshaped tail, and plantar support cleanup are offline adaptations. UUIDs, hashes, exact cleanup counts and QA are recorded in content/beasts/screen_peng.json; zero new generation, Rodin credits or TTS requests.
